4 ITI Student Handbook ITI AT A GLANCE Empowering Egypt’s youth since 1993 through world-class ICT training, innovation, and inclusive access to opportunity. The Information Technology Institute (ITI) is Egypt’s premier hub for ICT capacity building, operating under the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT). With 22 branches and training centers nationwide, ITI has empowered tens of thousands of young professionals since 1993 through cutting-edge

of thousands of young professionals since 1993 through cutting-edge programs in software development, data science, design, AI, cybersecurity, animation, and more. ITI’s mission is to bridge the gap between education and employment by offering intensive, hands-on training aligned with global market demands. Through partnerships, innovation labs, and outreach efforts, ITI continues to expand access to quality training and digital careers across Egypt. MISSION
expand access to quality training and digital careers across Egypt. MISSION A leading reference in preparing a strong and wide base of professionals in information and communication technology sector

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS All documents must be submitted no later than the official program start date. 10 ITI Student Handbook CODE OF CONDUCT & DRESS CODE All students are expected to maintain a respectful, responsible, and professional demeanor at all times. The following principles apply to both online and onsite settings: CONDUCT PRINCIPLES Show respect for instructors, staff, fellow students, and all ITI personnel. Maintain the integrity of facilities, equipment, and shared learning environments. Participate actively in lectures, discussions, and team activities.

environments. Participate actively in lectures, discussions, and team activities. Follow ITI policies regarding academic honesty and constructive feedback. The institute maintains a zero-tolerance policy for misbehavior and abusive or offensive language. Disciplinary action may be taken for any behavior that disrupts the learning environment or tarnishes our values. DRESS CODE Students must present themselves in a manner appropriate for a professional training environment.

Students must present themselves in a manner appropriate for a professional training environment. This applies during both in-person attendance and online sessions: Wear clean, modest, and tidy attire at all times. Closed-toed shoes are mandatory onsite. Avoid shorts, ripped jeans, slippers, flip-flops, or beachwear. Skirts must be at or below the knee. Hair should be neat and grooming should align with Egyptian workplace norms.

Hair should be neat and grooming should align with Egyptian workplace norms. Face coverings (such as niqabs, masks, or caps) must be removed during exams, assessments, or identification processes for security purposes. Note: If a student’s attire is deemed inappropriate, Student Affairs reserves the right to issue a verbal or written warning and require a change of dress.

11 ITI Student Handbook PROHIBITIONS The following actions are strictly forbidden and may result in immediate disciplinary procedures: Smoking anywhere on campus (including restrooms and open spaces). Eating or drinking inside computer labs, classrooms, or near electronic equipment. Using mobile phones during lectures or exams without permission. Engaging in political, religious, or commercial activities on ITI premises. Upholding the ITI code of conduct contributes to a safe, inclusive, and
Upholding the ITI code of conduct contributes to a safe, inclusive, and effective learning environment for all. “People Develop Countries… We Develop P.E.O.P.L.E.”

13 ITI Student Handbook ASSESSMENT & GRADING Understanding how your performance is assessed is the key to your success at ITI. This section outlines how assignments, exams, and overall progress are evaluated throughout the program. COURSE OUTLINE Your course syllabus, which explains learning goals, how you’ll be graded, and all key deadlines, will be available online. ASSIGNMENTS All assignments must follow provided instructions. Late submissions are penalized with a 5-point deduction per

Late submissions are penalized with a 5-point deduction per day unless an extension is granted in advance. EXAMS A minimum of 60% is required to pass any course. Some tracks may use cumulative assessments. Late arrival up to 20% of exam time is allowed with penalty; more than that, the student loses the right to take the exam. One corrective exam may be granted at the discretion of the Academic Supervisor. CORRECTIVE EXAMS Only one opportunity is granted for a corrective exam

CORRECTIVE EXAMS Only one opportunity is granted for a corrective exam per subject, subject to Academic Affairs approval. Failing the corrective exam results in course failure. PROGRESS REVIEW Students who fail two courses during the program will be dismissed. Continued poor performance or failure to meet project milestones may trigger additional academic review. ACADEMIC INTEGRITY Students must submit their own work and cite all sources. Plagiarism or cheating leads to a score of zero,

sources. Plagiarism or cheating leads to a score of zero, exam dismissal, and possible disciplinary action. Misuse of AI, sharing answers, or unapproved collaboration is also prohibited. When in doubt, ask your instructor.

16 ITI Student Handbook TRANSCRIPTS & RECORDS Each graduate receives one official transcript upon program completion. Additional copies are available upon request for a fee. All transcript requests must be made in person or via official email to the Student Affairs Office. Requests by phone or fax are not accepted. Transcripts issued to third parties (such as employers or embassies) require a signed authorization letter from the student.
authorization letter from the student. Processing time for transcripts may take up to five working days. ITI does not issue unofficial transcripts or academic records through informal channels.

معهد تكنولوجيا المعلومات (ITI) مؤسسة تابعة لوزارة الاتصالات وتكنولوجيا المعلومات المصرية. يقدم المعهد برامج تدريبية تهدف إلى إعداد كوادر تقنية متخصصة تخدم سوق العمل المحلي والدولي. أبرز البرامج تشمل برنامج التدريب الاحترافي لمدة 9 أشهر (9-Month Program)، وبرنامج التدريب المكثف (3-Month Intensive Code Camp)، وبرامج التدريب الصيفي للطلاب، بالإضافة إلى مبادرات التعلم الإلكتروني مثل مهارة-تك (Mahara-Tech).

شروط القبول في برامج معهد تكنولوجيا المعلومات ITI: 1. الجنسية المصرية. 2. التخرج من إحدى الجامعات المصرية أو المعاهد العليا المعتمدة. 3. التفرغ الكامل أثناء فترة التدريب وعدم الارتباط بعمل أو دراسة أخرى. 4. اجتياز اختبارات القبول الإلكترونية التي تشمل: اختبار اللغة الإنجليزية (English)، واختبار القدرات الذهنية والذكاء (IQ Test)، والاختبار التقني التخصصي (Technical Test). 5. اجتياز المقابلة الشخصية (Interview) التي تقيس المهارات الشخصية والتقنية ومدى الالتزام.

المسارات التقنية في ITI تشمل: - الذكاء الاصطناعي وتعلم الآلة (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning) - تطوير الويب المتكامل (Full-Stack Web Development باستخدام MERN و .NET و Python) - الأمن السيبراني واختبار الاختراق (Cybersecurity & Penetration Testing) - الحوسبة السحابية و DevOps (Cloud Computing & DevOps) - تطوير الألعاب والواقع الافتراضي (Game Development & VR/AR) - تحليل البيانات وعلوم البيانات (Data Science & Analytics) - النظم المدمجة وإنترنت الأشياء (Embedded Systems & IoT)
- النظم المدمجة وإنترنت الأشياء (Embedded Systems & IoT) جميع هذه المسارات مجانية 100% ويحصل المتدرب على مكافأة شهرية وشهادة معتمدة بعد التخرج.
